name: Thanisandra-Kannur
tagline: The Kannur address behind the Thanisandra headline.
description: This guide covers the Kannur side of the wider Thanisandra–Hennur residential corridor. Kannuru Main Road and connections towards Bellahalli and Chikkagubbi define the local approach. Project marketing may use Thanisandra, while the registered site address identifies Kannur Village and Bidarahalli Hobli.
